name: application-mortgage-calculator
title: Mortgage Calculator
description: Home price, down payment, interest rate, and loan term inputs with a computed estimated monthly payment, plus a compact result-summary card breaking payment down by principal, taxes, and insurance.
useWhen: A real estate or lending site needs to let users estimate a monthly mortgage payment from a few basic inputs.
Presenting an already-computed payment estimate broken down into principal/interest, taxes, and insurance for transparency.
avoidWhen: You need a general currency conversion tool with no loan amortization logic — that's a distinct calculator with different inputs and math.
The audience needs a fully amortizing payment schedule table rather than a single monthly estimate — this component is a quick estimator, not a full amortization tool.
responsiveBehavior: The input form uses a 2-column grid that can collapse to a single column on narrow viewports; the result card and summary breakdown are single-column and reflow naturally at any width.
accessibility: Every input has a visible, associated <label>, and currency/percent/year units are shown as adjacent text rather than only implied by placeholder content.
The computed monthly payment is presented as plain text at a large size so it reads clearly even without the surrounding visual treatment.
The compact summary's segmented bar is accompanied by a text legend with colored swatches, so category breakdown is never conveyed by color alone.
